attempt_log_path.principle: Path to the JSONL attempt log written by this receipt run.

duplicate_solve_claimed.principle: Must remain false; pre-reproduced targets improve receipts or retire the patch instead of claiming credit.

duration_s.principle: Measured wall-clock seconds for registry precheck, live route, attempt-log write, and artifact construction.

field_principles.attempt_log_path: Path to the JSONL attempt log written by this receipt run.
field_principles.duplicate_solve_claimed: Must remain false; pre-reproduced targets improve receipts or retire the patch instead of claiming credit.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall-clock seconds for registry precheck, live route, attempt-log write, and artifact construction.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Must start with complete: or blocked_ and state level_delta and patch decision.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use offline_arcade_live_agent_runtime_self_discovery_no_llm unless a mandated local SOTA GGUF proposer actually ran.
field_principles.input_checksum: sha256 over registry, Exp5240 artifact, patch file, and target configuration.
field_principles.level_delta: Integer level delta accepted after registry and provenance gates; zero means no solve was banked.
field_principles.levels_reproduced: List of levels banked by this receipt; empty when no solve is claimed.
field_principles.output_checksum: sha256 over the attempt-log rows before final artifact checksum.
field_principles.provenance_route_receipts: Receipts proving the live path reached the Exp5240 guard and avoided forbidden methods.
field_principles.registry_precheck: Records registry total and whether the target level was already reproduced before the live attempt.
field_principles.retire_current_provenance_patch: True when clean receipts leave level_delta=0 and the current provenance patch scope should be retired.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Records the attempted solve-credit route; no level is banked unless live_agent_self_discovery also passes registry validation.
